scope: Biological interpretation of Q4 ENSANUT adjustment pattern and current repeated-request lipid analysis; not a clinical review or new numerical validation.

sources.access: Full HTML accessed; Methods 2.2/2.3, Table 1 and cohort eligibility inspected.
sources.supports: Taiwan Biobank age range, prior-diagnosis restriction, nonuniversal fasting and age/sex-only regression; the fully adjusted target transfer remains an assumption.
sources.does_not_establish: Mexican eligibility equivalence or a glucose-adjusted BMI coefficient.

sources.kind: primary observational study and its original supplementary methods
sources.access: Main text indexed primary HTML and original supplement text accessible; publisher DOI returned 403. Supplement biomarker/interview methods pp. 4-6 (printed PDF pages 5-6 for lipid measurement) inspected.
sources.supports: Study recruitment/lifestyle context; fasting recorded, not universal; EDTA venous sample and CardioChek TC/HDL measurements; LDL calculated.
sources.does_not_establish: Our selected-case residual estimator, an assay-error magnitude, or exact measured-output component identity.

sources.access: PubMed abstract and indexed PMC methodological text accessible; direct PMC requests intermittently returned a challenge page.
sources.supports: Adjustment interpretation depends on causal structure and estimand; adjusting for an intermediate does not automatically identify the desired total effect.
sources.does_not_establish: A causal graph for BMI, measured glucose and HbA1c in this project.

source_review_boundary: Other construction-paper details come from existing independent source reviews, not a new reading of every original. Only three distinct targeted studies/methods papers were browsed. Supplement is part of the Lea study.
reference_boundary: Both evaluation contexts were previously exposed developmental project references. No fresh confirmation or validated clinical threshold is claimed.
note: Web retrieval traffic was not locally measured; no original article/data payload was written to the project by this review.
